component.name: Muvrix
component.summary: Modern native desktop media player with advanced video shaders and pro audio DSP

description.p: Muvrix is a fast, beautiful, and extensible native media player built in Rust and powered by libmpv. Designed for modern desktops, it offers uncompromising performance and an exquisite user interface.

ul.li: GPU-accelerated rendering and color management pipeline
Interactive 10-band graphic equalizer, Bauer headphone crossfeed, and dynamics compressor
Custom video shader pipeline, real-time tone mapping, and HDR display calibration
High-performance media library indexing with SQLite FTS5 search
Queue management with smart weighted shuffle and multi-format playlist import/export
Hardened network streaming with auto-reconnect and demuxer buffer management
Native desktop integration with Linux D-Bus MPRIS v2 and display sleep inhibition

description.p: Production release introducing the full Phase D feature suite.
